notes: Opt-in API comparison; the wrapper reparses and materializes each query. Native prepared parsing is outside timing.
Native modes use a long-lived session, matching the wrapper connection lifetime.
Memory SQL/data/parameters match compare/plan.json; warmups/iterations are increased for this diagnostic.
Additional shapes require explicit --workloads or --plan selection. An explicit plan retains its own schedules; existing default schedules remain unchanged.
Validation uses a separate database and instrumented callbacks. Timed callbacks have no counting or hashing.
All query results are fully drained, including the eager API. Validation digests include values, metadata and costs.
File mode uses read-only auto-locking opens, 50000 warmups and 5 batches of 5000 deterministic lookups.
Host buffered site has a bucket index and selects 500 rows; streamed site selects 1000 rows. Actual batching is recorded in validation.

workloads.name: pk_hit
workloads.sql: SELECT score FROM items WHERE id = $1

workloads.name: indexed_join
workloads.sql: SELECT a.label, b.score FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id AND b.bucket <> 3 WHERE a.id = $1 ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 1

workloads.name: three_table_join
workloads.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id WHERE a.id = $1 AND b.id = $1 AND c.id = $1 ORDER BY a.id

workloads.name: three_table_join_miss
workloads.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id WHERE a.id = $1 AND b.id = $1 AND c.id = $1 ORDER BY a.id

workloads.name: three_table_join_range
workloads.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id WHERE a.id < $1 AND b.id < $1 AND c.id < $1 ORDER BY a.id

workloads.name: three_table_computed_key
workloads.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id + 1 JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id WHERE a.id = $1 AND b.id = $1 + 1 AND c.id = $1 + 1 ORDER BY a.id

workloads.name: four_table_join
workloads.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label, d.bucket FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id JOIN items d ON d.id = c.id WHERE a.id = $1 AND b.id = $1 AND c.id = $1 AND d.id = $1 ORDER BY a.id

workloads.name: three_table_left_fence
workloads.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id LEFT JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id AND c.bucket <> 3 WHERE a.id = $1 AND b.id = $1 ORDER BY a.id
